'''Net'lseb Toli Park''' was a park located on the [[Gar'glum Sea]], on the outskirts of [[Gal'fian'deprisi]] City on [[Galantos]]. It was a kilometer-wide garden of [[toli tree]]s, fragrant blossoms, and wildlife enclosed in an energy perimeter. The park was a primary tourist attraction among [[Fian/Legends|Fia]] from other parts of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], as it had a security force that shot any [[skree-skater]]s that approached.
